dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with high-contrast white-to-light-grey borders enclosing darker interior patches. Edges exhibit jagged, non-uniform transitions with high pixel intensity gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical, solid high-intensity white clusters scattered between the larger annuli, particularly concentrated along the lower lateral boundary and near the pectoral flipper base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most prominent dorsal ring structures form an irregular, elongated trapezoidal polygon oriented along the longitudinal axis of the torso.
